concerns.text: FR-009 is internally contradictory about the noise protocol: it specifies a fixed 'Gaussian noise (σ=0.5°)' injection but in the same sentence requires 'sweeping the noise level to simulate sensor uncertainty'. A single fixed σ and a sweep are different procedures; pick one (e.g., 'sweeping σ over a range including 0.5°') so the requirement is self-consistent. The Assumptions section repeats only the fixed σ=0.5° variant, deepening the ambiguity.
